  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  RECREATION COMMISSION
  TUESDAY, APRIL 21, 2026 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the
Recreation Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Monday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the Community Services Department at (626) 300-0791 or at KShigenaga@SanMarinoCA.gov
48 hours prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do its best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to KShigenaga@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day of the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will be
  distributed to the Recreation Commission during the meeting. Any comments
  received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided

   to the Recreation Commission at the meeting.
  2. Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference
  module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-
  person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Commissioner Chang, Commissioner Raichlen, Commissioner Ton, Vice Chair Tsai, and Chair
Wu

POSTING OF AGENDA

The special meeting agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each meeting at the following
locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive,
and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The special meeting agenda is also posted
on the City’s website: http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Recreation
Commission on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the
Recreation Commission. Pursuant to state law, the Recreation Commission may not discuss or
take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The
Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

This is an opportunity for members of the Recreation Commission to inform the public and
staff of any meetings, events, or conferences they may have attended. In addition,
Commissioners may provide feedback related to program and service offerings.

  NEW BUSINESS

1.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission approve the minutes of the
  special meeting of February 9, 2026. If the Commission concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of February 9, 2026.

2.  DIRECTOR AND RECREATION MANAGER REPORT

AGENDA – APRIL 21, 2026  PAGE 2 of 3
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission receive and file the Director
  and Recreation Manager Report. If the Commission concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Director and Recreation Manager Report.”

3.  FY 2026-27 PROPOSED BUDGET
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission review and provide feedback on
  the FY 2026-27 proposed budget.

4.  PROPOSED ROUTE MODIFICATION FOR THE 4TH OF JULY
  PARADE
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission review and provide feedback on
  the proposed route modification for the 2026 4th of July Parade.

5.  4TH OF JULY PARADE GRAND MARSHAL SELECTION PROCESS
  AND A CALL FOR (2) PARADE COMMITTEE MEMBERS
  Recommendation:  Staff  recommend  the  Commission  nominate  two
  Commissioners to serve on the 4th of July Parade Committee. If the C o m m i s s i o n
  c o n c u r s w i t h t h e s t a f f ’ s r e c o m m e n d a t i o n , an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to nominate  and  to serve on the 4th
  of July Parade Committee.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the Recreation Commission. All public writings distributed by the City
of San Marino to at least a majority of the Recreation Commission regarding any item on this
agenda will be made available at the Stoneman Building located at 1560 Pasqualito Drive,
San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the Recreation Commission meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

Posted: April 16, 2026  EDDIE COVARRUBIAS
  COMMUNITY SERVICES DIRECTOR
